implementation_ontology.actual_algorithm: Group same-address increments by warp peers and issue one atomic update per peer leader. JACC.shared copies a 256-key template into dynamic shared memory; barrier plus 32-peer comparison selects one Atomix updating leader.
implementation_ontology.work_item_mapping: 256-thread workgroups in most cases; atomicReduction explicitly sweeps block sizes and widths. See command/config hashes for each measured case.
implementation_ontology.data_layout: Contended small output arrays and contiguous input/key vectors where used.
implementation_ontology.resource_policy: Dynamic shared memory, explicit 1024 bytes; JACC.shared copies full 256-key template; block barrier.
implementation_ontology.host_device_boundary: Input/reset, timed loop and output copy follow the saved named contract; atomicReduction includes output reset within timing.

failure_history.interpretation: Only preserved checks are known; missing historical CUDA.jl effort is not zero.

cuda_jl.actual_algorithm: Group same-address increments by warp peers and issue one atomic update per peer leader. 32 shuffle/ballot iterations derive peer masks, ffs/popcount select leader and CUDA.atomic_add! updates; helper also broadcasts previous counter.
cuda_jl.work_item_mapping: 256-thread workgroups in most cases; atomicReduction explicitly sweeps block sizes and widths. See command/config hashes for each measured case.
cuda_jl.data_layout: Contended small output arrays and contiguous input/key vectors where used.
cuda_jl.resource_policy: Warp register operations; no shared-memory tile.

native_to_model_mapping.reason: Native match-any warp intrinsic is represented by a 32-step shuffle/ballot peer-mask loop; still warp-level aggregation, distinct from KA/JACC shared-peer mapping.

cuda_jl.host_device_boundary: Input/reset, timed loop and output copy follow the saved named contract; atomicReduction includes output reset within timing.
